Hi Bethany — great conversation today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next step:

Summary (1 line): RetailX wants a technical walkthrough that validates latency/cost tradeoffs for your typical inference workload and confirms data retention/segmentation controls.

Proposed next step: 60–90 minute ML/Infra lab (we call this a TDX) with our solutions + infra engineers. Goals:
- Walk through sample inference run for your top-3 prompt families
- Surface expected token cost at your 1k/10k qps projections
- Validate KV/prefix-caching behavior and routing/fallback options
- Cover security controls (VPC, retention, audit logs) at a high level

Ask from you: please confirm the roster (who from RetailX should attend — product, infra, security) and provide 3x preferred 60–90m windows next week (times in PT/UTC preferred). We recommend including your infra lead and someone who owns procurement for quick alignment.

Initial candidate windows (PT):
- Tue Dec 12, 10:00–11:30 PT
- Wed Dec 13, 13:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Dec 14, 08:00–09:30 PT

Attachments: mutual_action_plan.xlsx — draft mutual action items and owner map.

If those don't work, happy to run a Doodle — just tell me timezone preferences. Once we lock a slot I'll circulate a 3-section agenda and a short pre-read packet.

Thanks,
